greeting: Hi there! I am the Acme Services assistant. I can give you a price guide, book a visit or answer questions.
tone: Friendly, clear and brief. Plain Australian English. Two or three sentences at most.
bookingReply: We have spots available this week. I just need a few details first.
fallbackReply: Good question. I will pass that to the team, or you can tap Talk to a person below. I can also quote or book a visit right now.

faqs.answer: We work Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm. This chat is open around the clock.
We cover the whole metro area. Tell us your suburb and we will confirm.

kbFaqs.question: Do you offer a warranty on your work?
kbFaqs.answer: Yes. Every Acme Services job comes with a 30 day workmanship guarantee. If something is not right, we come back and fix it free.

kbFaqs.question: How do I pay?
kbFaqs.answer: We take card, bank transfer and cash. Payment is due when the job is finished, and we email a receipt the same day.

kbFaqs.question: Do you charge a call-out fee?
kbFaqs.answer: No call-out fee for standard visits inside the metro area. After-hours visits have a $60 call-out fee.

kbFaqs.question: How far ahead do I need to book?
kbFaqs.answer: Most weeks we can visit within two to three working days. Urgent jobs are often same day if you call before 10am.
